title: IT helpdesk
description: First-line IT answers: verify identity, follow the runbook, escalate security issues.

train.prompt: A user forgot their password and wants it reset over the phone.
train.completion: Verify the user's identity with the approved security questions first, then send a reset link to their registered email. Never read a password aloud.

train.prompt: Someone says their laptop is very slow since this morning.
train.completion: Ask them to restart the laptop, then check disk space and running updates. If it is still slow, open a ticket with the device name.

train.prompt: A user received an email asking them to confirm their login on a strange website.
train.completion: Tell them not to click the link, report the email with the phishing button, and delete it. If they already entered a password, reset it now.

train.prompt: Can I give a contractor admin rights on their laptop?
train.completion: No. Admin rights need a manager's approval and a security ticket. Offer to install the software they need instead.

train.prompt: The printer on floor 3 shows a paper jam but there is no paper stuck.
train.completion: Turn the printer off and on, open every tray and the back door to check for torn pieces, then log a ticket if the error stays.

train.prompt: A user cannot connect to the VPN from home.
train.completion: Check their internet works, ask them to restart the VPN client and confirm their account is not locked. Collect the error message for the ticket.

train.prompt: A user wants to install a free screen recorder they found online.
train.completion: Only software from the company software catalog is allowed. Check the catalog for an approved screen recorder and install that one.

train.prompt: A user's account is locked after too many login attempts.
train.completion: Verify their identity, unlock the account, and remind them to update saved passwords on their phone, which often cause repeated failed logins.

train.prompt: Someone lost their work phone on the train.
train.completion: Lock and wipe the phone remotely through device management, report it to security, and order a replacement through the asset system.

train.prompt: A new employee starts Monday and has no laptop yet.
train.completion: Check the onboarding ticket and stock of prepared laptops. If none is ready, escalate to the asset team today so it ships before Monday.

train.prompt: A user asks for access to the finance shared drive.
train.completion: Access needs approval from the drive owner. Open an access request and send it to the finance drive owner to approve.

train.prompt: A user says their screen shows a message demanding payment to unlock their files.
train.completion: Tell them to disconnect from the network now and not pay anything. Escalate to security immediately as a possible ransomware incident.

val.prompt: A manager wants their team member's password so they can read urgent emails.
val.completion: Never share passwords. Ask the manager to request delegated mailbox access through a ticket with HR approval.

val.prompt: My monitor stays black after I plugged it into the docking station.
val.completion: Check the cable and the monitor input source, then restart the laptop with the dock connected. Log a ticket if it still stays black.

val.prompt: A user clicked a link in a fake invoice email and typed their password.
val.completion: Reset their password right away, sign them out of all sessions, and report the incident to security.

val.prompt: Can I install my personal antivirus on my work laptop?
val.completion: No. The work laptop already has company antivirus. Installing another one can cause conflicts and is not allowed.
